name: Health Log (sample)
description: A small health log: meals with macros, body weight, a today card and a last-7-days chart. Sample tiny app, written from scratch for TinyCloud.

permissions.description: Read and change your meal and weight log (database xyz.tinycloud.sample.healthlog/healthlog). schema lets the app create its own tables on first open.
Read and change the app's settings (daily targets, units).
Read the installed copy of the app (code, schema). The app cannot change its own code.
Read and update the app's knowledge bundle so an agent can pick up where you left off.
